records.name: Render Sandboxes
records.tagline: A computer for every agent
records.description: Render Sandboxes give every agent its own isolated Linux computer. Sandboxes starts in under a second and can run any agent or harness, like Claude Code or Codex. Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop. It wakes with files and memory intact. And you can reliably run thousands at once - all on the same platform as the rest of your app.

records.name: Zero Wire
records.tagline: Check your exposure to critical CVEs with one agent prompt
records.description: Zero Wire is a free vulnerability intelligence feed from Cloudflare Radar for security leads and engineers. Unlike CVE databases that list everything, it picks the critical issues in Internet-facing software and explains each in plain language: what's affected, who should check, and what to do now, with links to CVE records, vendor advisories and CISA KEV. Each briefing includes a ready prompt for your AI agent to run a read-only exposure check. No account needed.

records.name: Country Filter for X
records.tagline: Hide posts from chosen countries in your X For You feed
records.description: Pick countries or whole regions, and their posts disappear from X's recommended Home feeds: For You and topic tabs, on x.com and X Pro. It reads X's own "Account based in" data first, then conservative local signals, so uncertain posts stay visible. Your own posts, mentions of you, accounts you follow and saved usernames always stay. Works in every X display language. Free, open source (MIT), no tracking, no developer servers.

records.name: Rungle
records.tagline: Turn your running photos and clips into share-ready Reels
records.description: Rungle is a free iPhone app that turns your runs into posts. Import distance, pace, heart rate and more from Apple Health (or a screenshot of your running app) and put them on your photos with stylish overlays. AI best cuts picks shots worth sharing, and Reel templates like KM Splits and Spider Shot come with filming guides. Running Courses helps you find your next route on a map. Keep your running app. Rungle handles the edit.

records.name: Eyecon
records.tagline: Auto pause video when you look away
records.description: Eyecon pauses the video when you stop looking at the screen, and starts it again when you look back. Someone talks to you. You reach for something. You fall asleep. The video keeps playing, you miss a few minutes, and then you drag the progress bar around hunting for the spot where you left off. Eyecon removes that whole loop. The front camera checks one thing: whether your eyes are on the screen. When they are not, Eyecon sends a pause to whatever app is playing.

records.name: Chorus Weather
records.tagline: Know when to trust the weather forecast
records.description: Your weather app shows one forecast, blended from several big computer models. When they agree, you can trust it. When they don’t, it’s closer to a coin toss, and you’d never know. Chorus compares ECMWF, the US GFS, Germany’s ICON and the UK Met Office and sums them up in one word: Agree, Mixed or Split, with a plain-English reason. Widgets show the verdict at a glance. Free for iPhone. Chorus Plus adds widgets, two extra models and 20 saved places, with a one-week free trial.

records.name: Hindsight Models and Inference API
records.tagline: Small, fast models for reranking, embeddings and decisions
records.description: Hosted models for the steps around your LLM: reranking, embeddings and typed decisions. Point your Cohere or OpenAI client at inference.hindsight.vectorize.io and keep your code. hs-rerank-1 and hs-embed-1 are the most accurate small open models on our benchmarks and run fast on a CPU; hs-decide-1-flash answers yes/no, pick-one and how-likely questions in 167 ms, instead of an LLM call. From $0.005 per 1M tokens, $5 free credit, open weights on Hugging Face.

records.name: Sendu
records.tagline: Drop files easily across your local network
records.description: Drop files easily over your local Wi-Fi: iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux, and Android TV. No cloud, no cables, no account — devices talk directly, end-to-end encrypted. Send photos, 4K videos, or whole folders in three taps at full local speed. Stream native-quality video to a D-pad Android TV app, or share a folder once and pull files from any device. Files never leave your network. P2P file transfer is free. Sendu Pro unlocks TV streaming and live shared folders.

records.name: Mellow Kids
records.tagline: Personalized sleep and development app for parents
records.description: Most baby apps track what happened. Mellow Kids explains why, and what comes next. 🌙 Understand today: Log sleep, feeds and diapers easily. Mellow spots changes and tells you why. A routine to adjust, or a phase that will pass. 🔮 Prepare for tomorrow: A heads-up before sleep and development change, so you feel ready for each new stage. 🌱 The right guidance at the right time: Evidence based support, from short naps to separation anxiety and first tantrums.

records.name: KREV AI

records.name: fileForensics
records.tagline: Real or not? Check files before your AI trusts them.
records.description: fileForensics is a trust check for every file your app or agent acts on. Extraction tells you what a document says; fileForensics tells you whether to believe it. It looks for signs of editing, AI-generated content, tampering and details that don’t add up, then returns findings with the evidence: what, where and why. No black-box score. All delivered in one call and works via API, MCP (Claude, Cursor, Codex), the developer portal and the fileAI platform. Check the file before you trust the data.

The video keeps playing, you miss a few minutes, and then you drag the progress bar around hunting for the spot where you left off. Eyecon removes that whole loop. The front camera checks one thing: whether your eyes are on the screen. When they are not, Eyecon sends a pause to whatever app is playing.

Free plan available.

records.name: InventarQR
records.tagline: Plug&Play Warehouse Management System
records.description: Tired of renting software and buying $2k PDA guns? InventarQR is a plug and play WMS that turns any smartphone into an industrial scanner. Why we’re different: • Lifetime License: One-time fee, never expires. Reseller-friendly. • 100% Offline Mode: Pick and scan seamlessly in dead zones. • GS1-128 Ready: Extract lot, quantity and expiry date in a single tap. • Live Sync: Native Shopify and WooCommerce integration. • Smart Routing: Create paths for pickers and start shipping.

records.name: Chorus Weather
records.tagline: Know when to trust the weather forecast
records.description: Your weather app shows one forecast, blended from several big computer models. When they agree, you can trust it. When they don’t, it’s closer to a coin toss, and you’d never know. Chorus compares ECMWF, the US GFS, Germany’s ICON and the UK Met Office and sums them up in one word: Agree, Mixed or Split, with a plain-English reason. Widgets show the verdict at a glance. Free for iPhone. Chorus Plus adds widgets, two extra models and 20 saved places, with a one-week free trial.

From $0.005 per 1M tokens, $5 free credit, open weights on Hugging Face.

Also includes a Unix timestamp converter, a Snowflake ID decoder, a free no-key JSON API for bot developers, a /timestamp Discord app and an MCP server for AI assistants. Free, no sign-up, runs in the browser.

records.name: VoxyAI
records.tagline: VoxyAI is a free AI assistant
records.description: A free AI assistant for Mac and Windows that runs entirely on your own hardware with companion apps for iOS and Android. Enjoy private, unlimited AI conversations, voice dictation, intelligent rewriting, document knowledge, and powerful automations without subscriptions, usage limits, or sending your data to the cloud.

records.name: Furr
records.tagline: Furry Social Network
records.description: Furr is the social network for the furry community: a place to share your fursona, your art and your fursuits, meet people who like the same things and find your pack. 🐾 Your profile and your fursonas Create your profile with species, pronouns, interests, links and gallery. Add all your fursonas with their colours, traits and personality, and choose your main one. 📝 Post and discover Share text, photos, GIFs, videos and polls.

records.name: Notes by Halo
records.tagline: Local Markdown notes your AI assistant can read and edit
records.description: Notes by Halo is a minimal Markdown notes app for Windows that keeps your notes as plainmd files in a folder you control. Version 1.1.0 adds keyboard-first navigation, a cross-note task overview (press Space), an interactive tour, and a built-in MCP server, so assistants like Claude Desktop and Cursor can work with your notes locally. Free on the Microsoft Store, in English and Japanese.

records.name: Ama Baby
records.tagline: All-in-one care app for the fourth trimester and beyond.
records.description: Many baby apps assume continuous internet, stable electricity, and budgets for premium imports, but real families often operate under different conditions. Ama Baby is a free, lightweight, all-in-one baby care web app designed for any device to easily track feeding, activities, growth milestones, and food sensitivities privately or synced with family/caregiver. Discover or create weaning recipes from your local foods, share & record moments, and let Ama holds the Archive.

records.name: Kingpin Market
records.tagline: Find and sell fingerboard gear just by asking ChatGPT
records.description: Ask ChatGPT for the best deals, a 34mm deck or a whole setup, and Kingpin answers from live listings. Selling? List your gear the same way, just by asking, and every listing gets its own Instagram Story card. Buyers pay by card at checkout, and Kingpin holds the payment until the item is delivered.

records.name: ReelToScript
records.tagline: Turn any TikTok, Reel or Short into a script in one click
records.description: Paste a link from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook or X and get every spoken word back in seconds, with timestamps. Copy the script or download TXT, SRT or VTT captions. The Chrome extension adds a "Get transcript" button right on the video. Free daily.

records.name: Flare AI
records.tagline: Cloud and SaaS audit investigations for vibe-coded teams
records.description: Shipping a vibe-coded project? Flare AI helps small teams investigate who gained access, what changed, and what needs attention in cloud and SaaS audit logs. Review findings and source evidence for AWS and Google Cloud, with Google Workspace and GitHub Enterprise Cloud audits in early access. Try the sample and help shape Flare as an early tester.

records.name: Branana
records.tagline: Guided brand builder for founders & small businesses
records.description: Build a brand that feels right for your business, without the guesswork or agency price tag. Branana combines designer-curated options, tailored recommendations and step-by-step guidance to help you create a complete brand yourself. Leave with the logo files, colour palette, fonts and online brand guide you need to start using your brand straight away.

records.name: SKILL LMS
records.tagline: French LMS for training providers and independent trainers
records.description: SKILL LMS is a French web LMS for training providers and independent trainers. Deliver courses, manage learner records and track progress in one workspace. Depending on the plan, AI helps prepare course content and updates for trainers to review before publication. Start with a limited free plan: 1 course and up to 5 learners per year. Paid plans support larger training volumes.

records.name: Kolekt
records.tagline: KoleKt — Stop Losing Your Visual Inspiration.
records.description: Your creative research is a mess. KoleKt is the ultimate visual memory workspace built to bring order to the chaos. With our lightning-fast board system, you can create unlimited boards and save unlimited photos per board. Best of all, our Google Chrome Extension lets you capture inspiration from anywhere across the web with a single click, instantly syncing images straight to your boards without breaking your workflow or forcing manual downloads.

records.name: Cosmic Horizon
records.tagline: Fly from the Solar System to the observable universe
records.description: Cosmic Horizon is a 3D universe explorer for iPhone and iPad. Fly from the Solar System through the Milky Way and the Laniakea Supercluster to the observable universe, built on real catalogs of about 500,000 stars and more than 400,000 galaxies.

records.name: Ghost Agent
records.tagline: Tells live sellers what to do next, mid-show
records.description: Most live-selling tools work before the show or after it. Ghost Agent works during it. Point it at your handle and your competitors' on Whatnot, TikTok Live, eBay Live or Fanatics Live. It reads chat velocity, room turnover and auction pacing live, and calls the next move while the show is still savable. Whale alerts when a known big spender enters your room, a category price book, and a post-show report with three fixes. Browser-based, nothing to install. 7 days free.

records.name: ConceptMRR
records.tagline: Ready-built startups with proven demand
records.description: Buy a ready-built startup modelled on a business with verified revenue. Full source code and documentation delivered in 1–2 weeks.

records.name: NotchiDex
records.tagline: A calm desktop island for Windows, with a pixel-art cat
records.description: NotchiDex puts a small island at the top of your screen: now playing, volume, timer and battery, plus Notchi, a pixel-art cat you can pet and feed. Free, no account, no telemetry, under 15 MB of RAM. Optional one-time Pro adds pets and a file shelf.

records.name: Leadport AI
records.tagline: Convert leads instantly & boost sales | Leadport.ai
records.description: Respond to new leads in 10 seconds. Leadport AI is a lead management platform that connects sales reps with new leads in as little as 10 seconds. It streamlines follow-ups and reporting, analyzes calls, summarizes conversations, and provides AI-powered feedback to improve sales performance.

records.name: Remene
records.tagline: Your MRI report explained in plain language
records.description: Remene opens your MRI in your browser, explains your images and your radiology report in plain words, and prepares a PDF for your doctor.

records.name: Wisteria AI
records.tagline: Think For Yourself
records.description: Wisteria is an AI tutor that helps students actually learn instead of simply giving them answers. It uses Socratic questioning to guide students through problems, adapts to their understanding, and tracks mastery over time. It also uses a voice module to ask students questions and get them to explain the concept, allowing them to understand the concept at a deeper level. Unlike typical AI chatbots, Wisteria is designed around one idea: AI should make you think, not think for you.

records.name: Morse Code Translator & Trainer
records.tagline: Text to Morse and back, with sound and a trainer. Free
records.description: Translate text to Morse code or decode Morse back to text, instantly. Hit Play to hear it, with adjustable speed (WPM) and tone, using standard PARIS timing, and turn on visual flash to see it blink. Type, paste, or use the virtual keyboard. A clickable International Morse chart covers letters, numbers and punctuation, and each entry plays its sound. Want to learn? The built-in trainer plays random words for you to decode and tracks your accuracy. No signup.

records.name: RoteCat: Auto Rotate & Control
records.tagline: Tablet stays vertical in YouTube fullscreen? Auto-rotate.
records.description: YouTube fullscreen stays vertical on your tablet? RoteCat rotates supported videos to landscape and restores your previous setting on exit. Includes a rotation bubble, Quick Settings tile, notifications and per-app orientation. Shorts excluded; compatibility varies. Accessibility/system-settings permissions required; bubble needs overlay permission. Free install with ads; optional one-time ad removal. Independent of YouTube. Our app. Search Google Play for RoteCat.

records.name: Istoriada
records.tagline: Learn history by playing — built for kids
records.description: Istoriada turns middle-school history into short summaries and playful games: timelines, matching, quizzes, and more. Built for Romanian 5th grade, covering all units — the alphabet of history, prehistory, the ancient Orient, Greece, Rome, the Geto-Dacians, Islamic civilization, and medieval Europe. Clear language, no boring walls of text. Free to play in the browser.

records.name: ScreenMake
records.tagline: Gorgeous App Store screenshots before your coffee gets cold
records.description: Nowadays, most App Store screenshots out there look like the same template with new colors. ScreenMake starts from your own app's screens and designs each one around its own idea, with a headline and layout that fit it. Like a screen? Keep it. Want something else? Describe the change in a sentence, or move any layer by hand. When the set is ready, translate it into 39 languages and publish to App Store Connect in one click.

records.name: LazyGEO
records.tagline: GEO done for you
records.description: LazyGEO is GEO (generative engine optimization) software: an AI team that gets your startup recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini. Every week it checks what these AI assistants answer when customers ask which tool to use, writes the pages they read on your own domain, pitches the lists they quote, and asks before anything goes out in your name.

records.name: BlackForge
records.tagline: Real time crypto market data for AI Agents
records.description: BlackForge measures the order books of the major crypto exchanges in real time: depth, liquidity added and pulled, order ladders and what actually traded. 150+ metrics for 14,000+ pairs, in a dashboard or over REST, MCP and a CLI.

records.name: Cutwords
records.tagline: Edit video with text and an AI editing agent
records.description: Cutwords turns your video into an editable transcript. Cut words to cut footage, let AI build a rough cut, then refine it on the timeline. Clean up speech, add captions, repurpose long videos into clips, and collect frame-specific feedback in one workspace. You stay in control of every edit. Start free in your browser.

records.name: Telagus
records.tagline: Run your CRM by asking ChatGPT or Claude
records.description: Telagus is an all-in-one CRM for small businesses. Leads, email and SMS campaigns, quotes, invoices, contracts, projects, attendance and payroll in one place, instead of a stack of separate tools. What's new: an AI call assistant answers inbound calls on your Telagus number, forwards to a real person when needed and books appointments. You can also run your CRM from inside ChatGPT or Claude. Forever Free plan. Paid plans start at $45/month.

records.name: Tune
records.tagline: Swipe songs, find new artists, compare taste with friends
records.description: Tune makes finding new music feel like a game. Swipe through 30-second previews or full songs, and every like saves straight to Spotify or Apple Music. Start a group with friends to get weekly awards, music personalities and a shared playlist every Friday. Each week you get a personalized recap made for sharing. And with Autopilot, you build your own algorithm: Tune keeps your queue full of new finds even when you’re outside the app.

records.name: Pondering: Frog Logic Puzzle
records.tagline: A daily frog logic puzzle. One frog in every pond.
records.description: One frog in every pond. Can you solve the puzzle? Welcome to Pondering, a colourful frog logic puzzle game where every move counts. Use your reasoning skills to place frogs in their ponds, solve increasingly challenging puzzles and enjoy a fresh brain teaser every day. The rules are simple, but the puzzles will make you think: Place exactly one frog in every coloured pond. No two frogs can share the same row or column. Frogs cannot touch each other, even diagonally. Keep the grass cells empty.

records.name: Scale Astro
records.tagline: Scale Astro – Your Personal Astrology & Horoscope Companion
records.description: Scale Astro is an astrology-focused mobile application designed to help users explore astrology and discover personalized astrological insights. The app provides a convenient digital experience for people interested in astrology, horoscope-related information and astrological guidance. Discover astrology in a simple and convenient way with Scale Astro. Developed by Scale Us Technologies LLP.

records.name: Electronic Invoicing Software
records.tagline: Digitize Transactions, Improve Accuracy, Ensure Compliance.
records.description: Streamline your business billing operations with a secure and automated digital invoicing solution. Generate, validate, and manage invoices with greater accuracy while reducing manual data entry and processing errors. Simplify tax calculations, maintain organised transaction records, and improve compliance with applicable e-invoicing regulations. it helps businesses accelerate invoice processing, improve transparency, and maintain better control over billing activities.

records.name: AVORIX
records.tagline: The Auto Transport Operating System
records.description: AVORIX is the Auto Transport Operating System, connecting vehicle shippers with vetted independent carriers through one unified platform. Individuals, dealerships, and businesses can access market-based pricing, book transportation, manage shipments, track deliveries, and handle documentation and payments. Our mission is to eliminate unnecessary middlemen, reduce costs, and make vehicle transportation simpler, smarter, and more transparent. Skip the Broker. Skip the Dispatcher.

records.name: Open Typography Foundation
records.tagline: World's largest free font archive & vector logo studio
records.description: World's largest public font archive — 500,337 verified open-source typefaces across 100 sovereign script vaults (Bengali, Latin, Arabic, CJK, Coding). Features: • Instant Font Browser: Test 500k+ fonts with direct single-click TTF downloads. • Logo & SVG Studio: Export scalable vectorSVG or 300 DPI transparentPNG logos. • 1-Click WebFont CDN: Instant @font-face and @import CSS snippets. • 100% Free: Permissive open licenses (SIL OFL, Apache 2.0, MIT). No sign-ups.

records.name: SmartReply
records.tagline: The keyboard that writes your reply
records.description: SmartReply is a system keyboard for iPhone and iPad that drafts your reply. Copy the message you're answering, or pick a screenshot — the text is read on your device — and you get up to five one-sentence replies you can send as they are. Tell it who you're talking to and the tone, and that steers the result. No account. No message history stored. Screenshots are OCR'd on-device, so the image never leaves your phone. Free daily AI replies and image scans. iPhone and iPad, one app.

records.name: Digital Ruler Pro
records.tagline: Your iPhone is already a ruler — it just needed calibration
records.description: Turn your iPhone into a precise digital ruler. Measure any object in seconds — in centimeters or inches, with no internet connection required. KEY FEATURES • Linear Ruler — accurate cm and inch measurement with a draggable pointer • 2D Measurement — measure length and width at the same time • Device Calibration — calibrate with a credit card, ID card or A4 paper so results stay reliable on any screen • Measurement History — save, review and manage every reading • Lock Mode — freeze the current…

records.name: FocusCap
records.tagline: Fastest screen recording for macOS
records.description: Record your screen with light speed. Auto-transcribe, trim and dub your recordings into any language with AI.

records.name: 7Frames - AI Screen Recorder
records.tagline: AI Screen Recorder with Auto Zoom & Guides
records.description: A Chrome extension that records your screen or browser tab and zooms in on clicks in tab recordings, plus screenshots and bug reports, with an optional cloud library and share links you can limit to signed-in users, a company domain or named viewers.

records.name: DAT Radar: Crypto Treasuries
records.tagline: Track crypto treasury stocks, holdings and valuations
records.description: DAT Radar is a free research tool for tracking 20+ public companies holding BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC and other digital assets. Explore reported crypto reserves, treasury transactions and acquisition history. Compare stock prices with estimated Treasury Asset Value (TAV) per share and identify premiums or discounts. Build a watchlist to follow companies that matter to you. Available on web, iOS and Android. Gross TAV excludes liabilities and dilution.

records.name: PowerGoodies
records.tagline: Earn rewards on every kWh you charge your EV
records.description: PowerGoodies is a free EV charging app that turns every charging session into rewards. Link your charging card once, charge as usual at partner networks and earn points on every kWh. Swap your points for gift cards in the in-app rewards shop. PowerGoodies is the official loyalty programme of Source EV in the UK and Ireland, and of TotalEnergies in the Netherlands and Belgium. Use the EV charging map to find partner charge points near you.

records.name: Liber: Home Library Catalog
records.tagline: Scan your books onto a bookshelf that looks like yours
records.description: Liber catalogs the books you own on iPhone. Scan barcodes or import Goodreads, and each book appears as its real spine on your shelves. Track reading, lending and quotes. Free for 100 books, no account, no ads, and your library exports free.

records.name: ScrollFit :Focus & Screen time
records.tagline: Earn app time with push-ups and squats
records.description: ScrollFit – Earn Your Screen Time Through Fitness What if every minute you spent scrolling had to be earned? ScrollFit turns screen time into motivation. Complete exercises like push-ups and squats to earn access to the apps you choose. With AI-powered exercise detection and a screen time bank, ScrollFit helps you build healthier digital habits while adding more movement to your day. Earn your scroll. Move your body. Take back control.

records.name: ContentDesk
records.tagline: Study why Instagram Reels work, line by line
records.description: ContentDesk breaks an Instagram Reel, or a script you're drafting, into five parts: hook, body, CTA, structure and payoff. Findings quote the exact line behind them, so you can see what earned or cost points. Analyze 5, 10 or 15 Reels from a creator side by side, compare two Reels or two scripts, and export transcripts as TXT, SRT, JSON or ZIP. Scores rate what a Reel says. They are not a prediction of views.

records.name: Meldwork
records.tagline: Set the Goal. Let Agents Work Together.
records.description: Meldwork is a local-first multi-Agent collaboration workspace for macOS. Selected Agents share context, discuss approaches, carry out authorized work, and check results with less manual coordination. Users set goals and permissions and step in when information or key decisions are needed.

records.name: DeliveryRadar
records.tagline: Know instantly when your email authentication breaks
records.description: DeliveryRadar watches your domain’s SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and TLS-RPT setup every day and emails you the moment something breaks: a new source failing, a record someone quietly changed, weak enforcement nobody caught. Built by a 2-person IT shop that found its own email authentication silently broken for months — these are the same checks we built to protect ourselves. Free instant scanner (no signup), or continuous monitoring with trend tracking and sender lookup for $19/mo.

records.name: AgentCheck Free Mini-Check
records.tagline: We audit your AI chatbot before it costs you customers
records.description: Your chatbot talks to customers while you sleep — but do you know what it's actually saying? AgentCheck is a security & privacy audit for small-business AI chatbots. We test what your bot leaks (keys, internal data, system prompts), what it promises (discounts and guarantees you never approved), and where it invents prices and policies. Start with a free mini-check. The full audit ($149 / $299 deep) is human-reviewed: a plain-English report with severity ratings and exact fixes.

records.name: Verijob_Europa.es
records.tagline: ​Portal de empleo europeo verificado 100%
records.description: Verijob_Europa resuelve la falta de confianza y los perfiles falsos en los procesos de contratación online en Europa. Va dirigido a candidatos y empresas que buscan contrataciones transparentes y seguras. Su característica principal y única en el mercado es que genera automáticamente el CV del demandante a través de su vida laboral, conectando talento real y verificado con ofertas de empleo fiables en todo el territorio europeo.

records.name: Ta3i.com
records.tagline: Build & Own Your Online Store
records.description: Multi-tenant store platform with subdomain storefronts, payment integration, and shipping automation for Algeria.

records.name: Refract
records.tagline: Create images and videos with every model in one studio
records.description: Refract is one studio for creating AI images and videos across today’s models. Start with a prompt, choose the model and controls you need, and keep finished generations in a private gallery. Creators get one workflow across providers: model discovery, credit estimates, reference uploads, video extensions, and downloads in one place. We’re building Refract for creators, marketers, and teams. Tell us which models you want next and where the workflow feels slow—we’re listening.

records.name: PostGrowly
records.tagline: Write X posts with AI, schedule them, and track results
records.description: PostGrowly helps X creators turn ideas, notes, and videos into editable posts, find stronger openings with Hook Lab, schedule approved content, and review performance. Start free, then choose a plan that fits your workflow.

records.name: Direct Openings
records.tagline: Software jobs straight from company career pages
records.description: Job boards are full of reposts, recruiter ads and listings that closed months ago. Direct Openings only lists jobs taken directly from companies' own career pages. • 4,300+ software roles at 90 product companies, in 51 countries • Refreshed every 6 hours: closed jobs disappear automatically • Every Apply button opens the company's own posting, with no middlemen • Filter by role, experience, country/city and how recently the job was posted Free. No sign-up needed to browse. No ads, no recruiters

records.name: Sayloe
records.tagline: Speak in one language. Write in another. On Mac.
records.description: Replying to clients in another language? Skip the constant trips to a translator. Sayloe is a lightweight Mac app that works right where you write. Select text and double-tap ⌘ to translate it, or use the same shortcut without a selection to dictate a reply. Speak in your language, translate your words, and review before inserting them into a supported field. From emails to everyday chats, spend less time copying and switching apps—and more time getting your message across.

records.name: The Extra Coach
records.tagline: Practice plans, animated plays & team calendars for coaches
records.description: Built by a middle school basketball coach who needed one place for everything. Drag drills into timed practice plans, draw plays and watch them animate step by step, run every team's season calendar, and share schedules, playbooks and game-day food sign-ups with parents and players. Snap a photo of a whiteboard play or printed schedule and it comes in ready to edit. Works on any phone or computer.

records.name: JobsWorkers
records.tagline: The Marketplace of Home and Personal Services
records.description: JobsWorkers is two apps for home and personal services, in English and Spanish. With "Jobs", you describe the job, compare quotes, profiles and reviews, and see the full price before you hire. With "Jobs Workers", independent pros join free, pay no lead fees or subscriptions, and quote what they want to take home. Every worker verifies their identity with Stripe Identity before quoting, the client scans the worker's code on arrival, and card payments go straight to the worker through Stripe.

records.name: Cyber Compliance Pro
records.tagline: Simplify Cybersecurity. Strengthen Compliance.
records.description: Cyber Compliance Pro helps Australian businesses strengthen cybersecurity, manage risk and simplify compliance. Access practical support for ISO 27001 certification, Essential Eight assessments, IRAP readiness, SOC 2 compliance and business continuity planning. Our services help organisations identify security gaps, prepare for audits and build stronger, more resilient operations

records.name: Scale Shorts
records.tagline: Create, Discover and Enjoy Short-Form Videos
records.description: Scale Shorts is a short-video platform designed to help users discover entertaining content, explore creative videos and share their moments with a wider audience. Why Scale Shorts? - Discover short-form video content. - Explore videos from different creators. - Share your own video content. - Enjoy an engaging mobile video experience. - Connect with a community of content creators. Scale Shorts is developed by Scale Us Technologies LLP.

records.name: Clipo
records.tagline: Turn your website into a product demo video.
records.description: Paste your website link, and Clipo makes a product demo video in your brand: your colours, fonts, logo, motion graphics, voiceover, and music on the beat. See the storyboard first, then edit by typing. Want to show it live? Record any browser tab, nothing to install, and every click zooms in on its own. Type "blur my email everywhere" and it stays blurred as the screen moves. Translate in one click, share a link that collects leads. First video free.

records.name: LightUp Tours
records.tagline: Hidden city stories, told right where they happened
records.description: LightUp is a map of hidden stories. Walk to a spot, press play and hear what happened right there: the protest that saved hundreds of men, the hippo that survived a war. Short audio stories in Berlin, Madrid, Bogotá and more, in 7 languages. Free on web and Android.

records.name: solar water heater repair
records.tagline: solar
records.description: Falcon Pumps Dubai offers water pumps, tanks, and solar water heaters with installation & maintenance services across Dubai and UAE.

records.name: PingAura.ai
records.tagline: Monetise AI | Enterprise AEO
records.description: Turn AI search into your new revenue channel. PingAura is an Enterprise AEO platform that shows brands where they win or lose the answer, and converts that visibility into leads. Optimise your brand for AI discoverability, attribute AI and referral traffic, track AI visibility, and get leads from AI search. PingAura also helps you create, run, and monitor the progress of your ChatGPT ads, end-to-end, from one platform.

records.name: ENTE Roomy V2
records.tagline: A 180° Flay-Opening Handbag with a Built-in LIGHT
records.description: Most luxury handbags suffer from the "black hole" interior where everyday essentials vanish, while utility-focused organised bags compromise on high-end aesthetics. ENTE Roomy V2 solves this for modern professionals who want ORGANISED ELEGANCE without looking like they are carrying a bulky tech pouch. Engineered with a 180° split-case opening, a built-in interior light, solid brass zippers, and a wall-mounting internal storage system. The rare combination of true ELEGANCE + FUNCTIONALITY

records.name: FLUX 3 Image
records.tagline: Generate and edit images with precise layout control
records.description: FLUX 3 Image is Black Forest Labs’ image generation and editing model with precise layout control. Place elements in bounding boxes, combine up to 10 reference images, edit specific regions without changing the rest, and generate at native 2K or 4K. It also supports text-to-image and agent-planned layouts. Try it in Playground or via the BFL API.

records.name: Bleepster
records.tagline: AI that bleeps profanity on YouTube
records.description: Bleepster mutes swear words in YouTube videos while the video keeps playing. It reads YouTube's own captions, and an AI checks them in context, so it catches slang, disguised spellings and mixed languages that a word list would miss. Only the word goes silent, or you can pick a classic bleep. A 4-digit Parent PIN locks the settings, and the audio never leaves your browser tab. Works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on Mac. The first 10 videos are free.

records.name: AlgoCademy
records.tagline: AI mock interviews: coding, code reading and system design
records.description: Practice coding interviews with an AI interviewer that asks questions, follows up and runs your code against hidden tests. Three kinds of rounds: coding (239 problems), code reading (fix bugs in code you didn't write, with an AI assistant that is sometimes wrong) and system design (102 problems, drawn on a board while you talk). You can talk instead of type. Every round ends with a scorecard and the lessons to practice next. Your first interview is free.

records.name: Onbeat Running
records.tagline: Running metronome
records.description: Onbeat plays a beat at your target cadence over whatever you're already listening to, music, podcasts, or nothing. Intervals change the beat each segment, and the Cadence Builder walks you up from your own baseline in twelve sessions over four weeks. Phone in your pocket, with your own headphones. Every feature is free. No ads.

records.name: Clear Browsing Data Except Kept Sites
records.tagline: Clear browsing data for every site except the ones you keep
records.description: Clear Browsing Data Except Kept Sites is a lightweight, open-source extension that removes the history entries, cookies, and site data of every site you have not chosen to keep. Add the sites you want to stay signed in to and remember on the settings page, then turn clearing on. Each time Firefox starts, the extension clears the history and cookies of all other sites. You can also clear on demand with Clear Now.

records.name: FutureFamily
records.tagline: Digital time capsules for your family, even an unborn child
records.description: Future is a digital time capsule app for families. Seal a photo, a video, a voice message or a letter today and choose exactly when it opens: on a date, on their 18th birthday, or as a series that unfolds over time. You can even write to a child who isn’t born yet: create a future member profile, and the day they join, every memory is waiting for them. Private by design: no public feed, no ads, data hosted in the EU. Free on iOS, in English, French and Spanish.

records.name: Wavumi
records.tagline: Make little games with your people, just by chatting
records.description: Wavumi is a private messenger for couples, best friends and family where you make little games and apps just by describing them. Type "@Wavumi a goodnight jar: one question a night, we see each other's answer once we both reply" and a few minutes later it's a card in your chat that everyone can play. Reply to change it, remix apps from the Plaza, and keep chatting or video calling while you play. Free on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: supastack
records.tagline: Production-ready Next.js, TanStack, Expo & Tauri monorepo
records.description: After building 10+ full-stack apps over 2 years, I extracted my internal architecture into Supastack: a unified, type-safe monorepo supporting Next.js 16, TanStack Start, Expo (iOS/Android), and Tauri 2.0 (Desktop) out of the box—complete with Drizzle ORM, auth, and 8+ payment gateways.

records.name: MyTools
records.tagline: 600+ free tools that run in your browser
records.description: MyTools bundles 600+ free tools — PDF, images, video, audio, dev utilities, and 16 AI tools (text, image, music, voice cloning) — in one place. Most run 100% client-side: files never leave your browser, no signup needed. The few that need a server, like the AI tools, say so on their page. Available in Spanish and English. Optional Lite/Pro plans remove ads and raise AI limits, but the whole local catalog stays free and unlimited on every plan.

records.name: WavMasta
records.tagline: Clean up and master your songs for release
